Reading it as a hold duration\n        // produced a wrong, confidently-reported measurement during this very investigation.\n        // The mkdir above IS the grant, so stamp the grant instant here and make it\n        // answerable instead of inviting the same misreading again.\n        writerOwner = { ...owner, acquiredAt: new Date().toISOString(), phase: \"draining-readers\" };\n        await writeFile(\n          join(lockDir, \"owner.json\"),\n          `${JSON.stringify(writerOwner, null, 2)}\\n`,\n        );\n        break;\n      } catch (error) {\n        if (error.code !== \"EEXIST\") throw error;\n\n        const elapsed = Date.now() - startedAt;\n        await announceWaiting(elapsed);\n        if (await reclaimAbandonedLock(lockDir, staleMs)) continue;\n        if (elapsed > timeoutMs) {\n          const currentOwner = await readOwner(lockDir);\n          throw new Error(\n            `Timed out after ${timeoutMs}ms waiting for fs-mutex \"${name}\" (${lockDir}); holder: ${currentOwner}`,\n          );\n        }\n        await sleep(retryMs);\n      }\n    }\n  } finally {\n    if (ticketRegistered) {\n      try {\n        await rm(myTicketDir, { recursive: true, force: true });\n      } catch {\n        // best-effort — a missing/already-cleaned ticket is not an error\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  try {\n    await waitForReaders(readersDir, {\n      timeoutMs,\n      staleMs,\n      retryMs,\n      startedAt,\n      onWaiting: opts.onWaiting,\n      waitingNoticeIntervalMs,\n    });\n    // WI-1490656: report how long admission actually QUEUED. A caller that re-acquires\n    // the same lock across many short sub-invocations (one affected-tests shard after\n    // another) otherwise has no way to bound its TOTAL queue time — each call's\n    // `timeoutMs` restarts from zero, so an N-shard run's real worst case is N × timeoutMs.\n    // Fires inside the try so a throwing callback still releases the lock.\n    if (opts.onAcquired) opts.onAcquired({ waitedMs: Date.now() - startedAt });\n    // A reserved writer can spend its entire wait draining existing readers.\n    // Publish the callback phase only after that drain, atomically so a peek\n    // cannot mistake a partially rewritten owner record for an absent lock.\n    const runningOwner = { ...writerOwner, phase: \"running\", runningAt: new Date().toISOString() };\n    const nextOwnerPath = join(lockDir, \"owner.next.json\");\n    await writeFile(nextOwnerPath, `${JSON.stringify(runningOwner, null, 2)}\\n`);\n    await rename(nextOwnerPath, join(lockDir, \"owner.json\"));\n    return await fn({\n      hasWaiters: async () => (await oldestTicketDir(ticketsDir, staleMs)) != null,\n    });\n  } finally {\n  return publishDependencyGeneration({ repoRoot });\n}\n\nfunction isInvokedDirectly(argv1, moduleUrl) {\n  if (!argv1) return false;\n  try {\n    return realpathSync(argv1) === realpathSync(fileURLToPath(moduleUrl));\n  } catch {\n    return false;\n  }\n}\n\nif (isInvokedDirectly(process.argv[1], import.meta.url)) {\n  main()\n    .then((status) => {\n      process.exitCode = status;\n    })\n    .catch((error) => {\n      console.error(\n        `NPM_INSTALL_SAFE_ERROR ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`,\n      );\n      process.exitCode = 1;\n    });\n}\n"}],"internal_chat_message_metadata_passthrough":{"turn_id":"01a11159-2b57-7832-ac91-8ba89d85d532","create_time":1791292813.4675727}},"metadata":{"client_authored":false,"fallback_token_limit_override":12000}}

\"\"}`,\n    FAKE_NPM_LOG: npmLog,\n    PAPERCUSP_SKIP_DEP_VERIFY: \"1\",\n    PAPERCUSP_SKIP_DEP_GENERATION: \"1\",\n  });\n  try {\n    // NPM_INSTALL_SAFE_SUBJECT lets scripts/mutation-probe.sh point this guard at a copy.\n    const subject = process.env.NPM_INSTALL_SAFE_SUBJECT;\n    const runMain = subject\n      ? {"timestamp":"2026-10-06T13:29:03.370Z","ordinal":561,"type":"event_msg","payload":{"type":"item_completed","thread_id":"01a11158-b6c7-7c23-8712-bc632b5004fa","turn_id":"01a11159-2b57-7832-ac91-8ba89d85d532","item":{"type":"McpToolCall","id":"exec-966ae618-0034-447b-bc8a-585758ee1a4c","server":"papercusp-su","tool":"facts:list","arguments":{"scope":"workspace","key":"root-cause:install-safe-resolution-writer","full":true},"readOnlyHint":true,"status":"completed","result":{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"{\"ok\":true,\"mode\":\"key\",\"key\":\"root-cause:install-safe-resolution-writer\",\"found\":true,\"count\":1,\"facts\":[{\"scope\":\"workspace\",\"ref\":null,\"key\":\"root-cause:install-safe-resolution-writer\",\"sourceRef\":\"EI-25223755767814811\",\"createdBy\":\"su-f0e98560-52c5-4afe-8709-46fef49a576e\",\"updatedAt\":\"2026-10-06 08:42:52.981804-04\",\"expiresAt\":\"2026-10-13 08:42:52.981804-04\",\"retractedAt\":null,\"retractedBy\":null,\"retractionReason\":null,\"confidence\":\"verified\",\"recheck\":{\"probe\":\"Read scripts/npm-install-safe.mjs main() and scripts/lib/fs-mutex.mjs withFsMutex after the EI-252237 fix.\",\"falsifier\":\"The writer callback no longer surrounds npm dependency resolution, or the work-item measurements are withdrawn.\"},\"kind\":\"conclusion\",\"body\":\"Verified root cause for EI-25223755767814811: before the fix, scripts/npm-install-safe.mjs acquired the repo writer before spawning the full npm install command, so ideal-tree resolution ran inside the exclusive lock. The report measured a 26-minute one-package add with no manifest/node_modules writes; a later same-shape add made git-sync time out waiting on the same lock. fs-mutex holds the writer until the callback returns.\",\"sourceProvenance\":{\"kind\":\"work-item\",\"verified\":true,\"verifiedAt\":\"2026-10-06T12:42:52.844Z\",\"quote\":\"install:safe holds the shared npm writer through dependency RESOLUTION (26+ min, 10 GB RSS for a one-package add), blocking every peer's tests and Tauri launch…\",\"label\":\"EI-25223755767814811 [bug/open @f0e98]\"}}]}"},{"type":"text","text":"See also: facts:assert; facts:retract"}],"_meta":{"format":"json","_seeAlso":[{"tool":"facts:assert"},{"tool":"facts:retract"}]}},"duration":{"secs":0,"nanos":357475978}},"started_at_ms":1791293343012,"completed_at_ms":1791293343370}}

{"timestamp":"2026-10-06T13:32:20.881Z","ordinal":655,"type":"response_item","payload":{"type":"custom_tool_call","id":"ctc_0056219f8eb2e0de016ac4f863bbcc819698bf77328d9e0936","status":"completed","call_id":"call_dc34fe74ffc148008558b0a220b74da8","name":"exec","input":"const r=await tools.mcp__papercusp_su__facts_assert({\n  scope:\"workspace\",\n  key:\"root-cause:install-safe-resolution-writer\",\n  sourceRef:\"EI-25223755767814811\",\n  kind:\"conclusion\",\n  confidence:\"verified\",\n  ttlSec:604800,\n  body:\"Verified root cause for EI-25223755767814811: install:safe previously acquired the repo writer before spawning the full npm install, so the measured 26-minute ideal-tree resolution (no writes) and same-lock git-sync wait were inside the exclusive callback. fs-mutex holds the writer through its callback. Post-fix, resolve from a scratch copy with no repo lock: even a shared reader blocks git-sync's exclusive writer. Regression proves a writer can acquire during resolve and is blocked during reify/repair.\",\n  recheck:{\n    probe:\"Inspect runManifestOnlyInstall at the resolver and apply phases, then run node --test scripts/npm-install-safe.test.mjs.\",\n    falsifier:\"A repo writer cannot be acquired during npm resolution, or the writer is not held for apply, reify, and repair.\"\n  }\n});\ntext(JSON.stringify(r.structuredContent??r.content??r));\n","internal_chat_message_metadata_passthrough":{"turn_id":"01a11159-2b57-7832-ac91-8ba89d85d532","create_time":1791293539.7416656}}}

{"timestamp":"2026-10-06T13:32:25.876Z","ordinal":659,"type":"response_item","payload":{"type":"custom_tool_call_output","id":"ctco_01a1116a-5d94-7c30-aad3-468f17b00d82","call_id":"call_dc34fe74ffc148008558b0a220b74da8","output":[{"type":"input_text","text":"Script completed\nWall time 5.0 seconds\nOutput:\n"},{"type":"input_text","text":"[{\"type\":\"text\",\"text\":\"{\\\"ok\\\":true,\\\"fact\\\":{\\\"scope\\\":\\\"workspace\\\",\\\"scopeRef\\\":null,\\\"key\\\":\\\"root-cause:install-safe-resolution-writer\\\",\\\"body\\\":\\\"Verified root cause for EI-25223755767814811: install:safe previously acquired the repo writer before spawning the full npm install, so the measured 26-minute ideal-tree resolution (no writes) and same-lock git-sync wait were inside the exclusive callback. fs-mutex holds the writer through its callback. Regression proves a writer can acquire during resolve and is blocked during reify/repair.\\\",\\\"sourceRef\\\":\\\"EI-25223755767814811\\\",\\\"audienceScope\\\":null,\\\"sourceProvenance\\\":{\\\"kind\\\":\\\"work-item\\\",\\\"verified\\\":true,\\\"verifiedAt\\\":\\\"2026-10-06T13:32:21.971Z\\\",\\\"quote\\\":\\\"install:safe holds the shared npm writer through dependency RESOLUTION (26+ min, 10 GB RSS for a one-package add), blocking every peer's tests and Tauri launch…\\\",\\\"label\\\":\\\"EI-25223755767814811 [bug/open @f0e98]\\\"},\\\"confidence\\\":\\\"verified\\\",\\\"measurement\\\":null,\\\"recheck\\\":{\\\"probe\\\":\\\"Inspect runManifestOnlyInstall at the resolver and apply phases, then run node --test scripts/npm-install-safe.test.mjs.\\\",\\\"falsifier\\\":\\\"A repo writer cannot be acquired during npm resolution, or the writer is not held for apply, reify, and repair.\\\"},\\\"kind\\\":\\\"conclusion\\\",\\\"dependsOn\\\":[],\\\"claim\\\":null,\\\"enforcement\\\":null,\\\"settledBy\\\":null,\\\"createdBy\\\":\\\"su-f0e98560-52c5-4afe-8709-46fef49a576e\\\",\\\"updatedAt\\\":\\\"2026-10-06 09:32:22.01169-04\\\",\\\"expiresAt\\\":\\\"2026-10-13 09:32:22.01169-04\\\",\\\"id\\\":202031,\\\"supersededAt\\\":null,\\\"supersedesId\\\":201536}}\"},{\"type\":\"text\",\"text\":\"See also: facts:retract; facts:list; memory:remember (fuzzy background instead)\"}]"}],"internal_chat_message_metadata_passthrough":{"turn_id":"01a11159-2b57-7832-ac91-8ba89d85d532","create_time":1791293545.8766384}},"metadata":{"client_authored":false,"fallback_token_limit_override":12000}}
